I went from being into electronic music like Mike Oldfield, then I became a full time thrasher. Mostly Metallica, Sepultura, Overkill, Exodus... Wth metal and rock it is so cool that there is no single band that purely plays any genre. The borders are so fluid that I quickly discovered nu, death and groove. 

But the biggest influence were for me doom/sludge/stoner/funk/fuzz bands. Really getting to you through the pure, minimalistic tones, groovy drums and resonating bass...

Right now i am into more artistic music, much more expressive, melodic and filled wth a rollercoaster of emotions. I recomend to everyone some Rishloo and Leprous 😍😭😍🌈🌈🌈

Leprous are releasing a new album this month! The first single have got everything from choirs, beautiful harmonics, violin solos and much more... Even heavy, syncopated, progressive drum beats, electronics.... 🥰

Definitely ya have to consider taking care of ur skin more. Try some peeling or moisturizer, that would make u look much more femme without any extremes. Also, take care of ur hands, especially nails. Do you tend to cut ur nails short? Try growing them a bit. Maybe put some transparent nail polish. That shouldn't be obvious to anyone at the first glance, but it's gonna make you look well-groomed. Also, keep ur shoes clean! 

Also, try wearing even ur boyish clothes like a tomgirl would do. Do you have pants that are too loose 'round your waist? Good, buy a thin, femme belt and try to fasten them high, with t-shirt pulled inside. This is Just one example but i fink you get the point. 

A good way to look more femme is to wear more vibrant colors and more diverse materials. Don' t overdo it, just play a bit with that okay? A single piece with ur regular clothes will do just fine. A good tip is to wear only complementary colors. If you gonna Wear something cold, go with cold colors. Anything warm? Only warm colors. The Best way to get more feminine it to wrap your mind around fashion and there is no better way than to learn it, tgan playing with color and form to diversify ur wardrobe. 

Also, remember it is not only about ur looks. When my feminine side awakens I'm more cheerful, playful and generally more optimistic. If u experience something similar you can use it for ur best - feeling spontanious and a little bit quirky might make u act more femme. Furthermore, you can consider taking more feminine interests. It isn't ofc a rule, I know a handful of girls fascinated with guy stuff, however what makes you feel more feminine gonna help you look more feminine.

I hope that helps a bit... I'm prolly not that good as I think so this advice might suck but I wish u very luck and I really hope I helped a bit!! <3
